svg.text: STARZ ELECTRONICS
H005/H006 — CUSTOM CUT-AXIS PLATES / R1
ENGINEERING DRAWING — RELEASE HOLD
Units mm · A3 · Do not scale dimensions
H005 BASE PLATE 6082-T6: 86 x 440 x 20;two HGR20 rail seats
milled flat 0.02/300,60 mm pitch M5;BK12 land at the fixed end,
BF12 land at the distal end;6x Ø6.6 base grid 46/100 to H001/H002.
Deburr;no hard anodise on the rail seats.
H006 CARRIAGE PLATE 6082-T6: carriage pad 60x75 at 46 mm;
blade-holder interface 4x M6 on 46x46 (datum A);
DSG16h nut pocket per the housing datasheet on the centreline;
block lands 4x M5 per the HGH20CA datasheet. NO F0/PCD70 pattern here.
H003 is the FIXED-END motor adapter (not on this plate).
The KK86 carriage envelope is NOT reproduced: the custom axis
is its own interface; the adapter FEM applies to H003 only.
PROCESS: plate stock, mill both faces, drill/tap from one fixture; nut pocket and pad in the same setup.
INSPECT: flatness, hole positions ±0.05, M6/M5 tapping depth, nut-pocket depth, block-land parallelism.
ASSEMBLY: rails to H005, blocks to H006, nut housing in pocket, screw through BK12/BF12; run-in 1 h;
re-measure preload and repeatability ±0.02 over 194 mm (DTI); record in the build record.
PARTS H005 · H006 · CUSTOM CUT AXIS (docs/39)
DIMENSION RECORD
RELEASE HOLD: physical run-in and repeatability record
